date_note: Pakistan Times gives no separate date for the advisory; 23 November is the article's publication day.
title: Pakistan's National CERT urges WhatsApp users to update over reported vulnerabilities
summary: Pakistan Times reports that Pakistan's National CERT issued an advisory covering WhatsApp vulnerabilities on Android, iOS, Windows and Mac. The article names no CVE or versions. It says National CERT urged users to install the latest versions of WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business without delay. The advisory itself was not read.
plain: Pakistan Times reports a national cyber agency alert telling WhatsApp users to update the app and avoid suspicious attachments and links.
exec: Pakistan's National CERT, per Pakistan Times, urges prompt WhatsApp updates.
action: National CERT advises, per Pakistan Times, installing the latest WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business versions from official sources and avoiding suspicious attachments and links.

validation.note: Only Pakistan Times was read; the National CERT advisory was not found or read.

review.note: plain said 'unexpected messages and files', which the article does not say; now 'suspicious attachments and links' as in the source. Title, date, platforms, no CVE and action otherwise match Pakistan Times
